sloka: यस्य नास्ति मनुष्येषु सदृशो राक्षसोत्तम।कथमाशंससे योद्धुं तुल्येनेन्द्रविवस्वतोः ।। ६.६४.१८ ।।
transliteration: yasya nāsti manuṣyeṣu sadṛśo rākṣasottama।kathamāśaṁsase yoddhuṁ tulyenendravivasvatoḥ ।। 6.64.18 ।।

translations.english: "O Best of Rakshasas! How would you enter into combat with one who is great among all human beings and while even Indra and Sun God are not equal to him in war?"
